An analysis of the issuer’s financial profile reveals exceptionally strong liquidity (current ratio of 3.83x) and a highly conservative capital structure, with total equity of $1,058 million dwarfing total liabilities of $290 million. While the company boasts an outstanding 94% gross margin and positive operating profitability, the massive accumulated deficit (retained earnings of -$1,564 million) indicates a history of significant past losses or aggressive recapitalizations, and the net income of $337 million exceeds operating income due to non-operating items that may not be recurring. Consequently, while the balance sheet currently reflects investment-grade strength, the historical volatility and earnings mix constrain the rating to the mid-to-high investment-grade category.

DECISION: A-
